en: Replace overlapping chat, stream, transcript, and tool contracts with domain-owned model types, branded identifiers, explicit persistence ports, and the new browser-safe /model entry point.
zh-CN: 以领域归属明确的模型类型、branded identifiers、显式持久化端口和新的 browser-safe /model 入口，替换重叠的 chat、stream、transcript 与 tool 契约。
